profile.headline: Software Engineer at Integrated DNA Technologies
profile.summary: Results driven engineer with 8 years of experience working on high performing teams doing analysis, design, development, and testing. Highly adaptable to picking up new languages and skills in both self-driven and team oriented roles.

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description:
Skills: Python, Django, React, HTML, CSS, Jenkins, Docker, Git (GitHub), Agile

- Web Applications oncology team

positions.title: Lead Engineer
positions.description:
SaaS company that built marketing tools to break down company silos. 

Skills: Amazon Web Services (Elastic Beanstalk, Relational Databases, S3), Python, Flask, REST API, Vue.js, HTML, CSS, Jenkins, Docker, Git (Phabricator), Agile

- Employee number three, first engineer at the company
- Lead team of two engineers to create proof of concept beta product that secured $1.5M seed funding from General Catalyst
- Manage team of three engineers to implement core business logic across frontend and backend technologies
- Engage with potential customers at company sponsored booths at conferences and trade shows
- Listed as one of Colorado's 50 startups to watch in 2020: https://www.builtincolorado.com/2020/01/21/50-colorado-startups-watch-2020

positions.title: Software Engineer in Test - Engineer III
positions.description:
Scale-out storage solution that was acquired by NetApp.

Skills: Python, Linux, REST API, Docker, Git (Phabricator, Bitbucket), Mercurial, Agile, SAFe, test, automation.

- Write and automate feature test suites against REST-like product API
- Coordinate and manage system level tests at scale to gather distributed system metrics
- Design custom test automation framework for multiple test organizations
- Implement CI/CD practices using Jenkins and Docker containers
- Program management using Scaled Agile framework (SAFe)

positions.title: Firmware Engineer - Engineer II
positions.description:
Storage company that primarily deals with spinning hard drives. 

Skills: C, Python, Perforce, Agile, embedded systems, customer and product management.

- Adopt and transition team to use Agile Scrum methodologies
- Debug firmware using bus analyzer, emulator, and serial port
- Deliver and delegate customer specific firmware requirements and features for consumer level desktop hard drives
- Coordinate firmware code delivery of two low-cost drive programs across manufacturing, servo, and project management teams

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
- Debug firmware
- Convert hard drive inquiry pages to persistent data format

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
- Collect and measure range testing results of RFID modules
- Programmed RFID modules and assisted in inventory and shipping

volunteerExperiences.description: Mentored two college students studying Computer Science. Both received summer internship and/or full-time job offers in the industry.
